# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update. This preview incorporates current upstream renderer fixes. Linux applications that rely on exact font fallback selection should review the change below before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback may select a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change selected glyphs or text metrics. Specify an explicit family and style, or bundle a typeface, when deterministic font selection matters. ([#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m153** — Brings the current upstream renderer and its bug fixes to the 4.153 preview line without changing the managed API surface. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.

## Preview 1 (September 3, 2026)

Preview 1 opens the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and its upstream fixes.
